name: MISS ~Interactive Hard Boiled~
source:
The Republic of Torunaba is a mixture of advanced technology and medieval townscape.

You play as George Sawaki, a private detective who finds himself involved in a huge conspiracy when searching for the whereabouts of his disappeared wife Anna.

Serial murders, breathtaking pursuits, fierce shootouts, figures in the shadow, a mysterious personality transplant device and the code name "MISS" ...

This case is way too dangerous. You have to be the one to solve it.
